And this is an even more endless placeholder example. Since we just rolled out this fresh sheet of paper for Stream, might as well slip in a tiny CSS snippet to check whether tabular numerals, code blocks, and cobalt highlights feel nimble in both light and dark ink.

quote.source: Let Blogs Be Blogs Again · No. 01

body: This is also an example — demonstrating the typographic cadence of a clipping with margin commentary: editorial serif holding the excerpt aloft, crisp sans below for whatever stray note follows.
这是一条示例。没有卡片边框、没有红点角标、也不必非得凑足两千字才配发出来——一页白纸，几行碎碎念，先让这块地方自由呼吸起来。

This is an example. No boxed cards, no notification badges, and no obligation to stretch a passing thought into two thousand words — just a quiet sheet of paper, a few lines of musing, and room to breathe.
